create_inference_batcher: create an InferenceBatcher instance with a predict unit and configurable max batch size for MLIP inference
use_inference_batcher_context_manager: use the InferenceBatcher as a context manager to automatically shutdown the executor after batched inference
access_batch_predict_unit: access the batch_predict_unit cached property to get a BatchServerPredictUnit for submitting batched predictions
shutdown_inference_batcher: call shutdown on the InferenceBatcher to gracefully stop the thread pool executor and pending tasks
get_concurrency_backend: get a thread pool concurrency backend executor for running ASE calculations concurrently with configurable max workers
